# Kurs

> Signed price feeds for Portaldot V3 (pallet-revive) and Ethereum Sepolia. Five reporters sign each observation (EIP-712); the contract takes the median when a strict majority agrees. Readable from Solidity, ink! and Substrate, and through the Chainlink, Pyth, DIA, Band, API3, Chronicle, Aave v3, ERC-7726, Euler IPriceOracle, Silo v2 and Morpho Blue interfaces, plus an on-chain TWAP.

Feeds: BTC/USD, ETH/USD, DOT/USD, USDT/USD, USD/IDR, TSLA/USD, NVDA/USD, AAPL/USD, AMZN/USD, META/USD, tPOT/pUSD. 8 decimals. feedId = keccak256(pair), e.g. keccak256("USD/IDR"). The HTTP API also accepts pairs case-insensitively with -, _ or / (usd-idr).

## HTTP API (no key, CORS open)

- [OpenAPI 3.1 spec](https://kurs-ten-zeta.vercel.app/openapi.json): all endpoints below
- [/api/feeds](https://kurs-ten-zeta.vercel.app/api/feeds): feed catalogue, ids, sources, AggregatorV3 addresses
- [/api/bundle?pair=USD/IDR](https://kurs-ten-zeta.vercel.app/api/bundle?pair=USD/IDR): freshly signed bundle; `payload` goes to KursOracle.fulfillOracleQuery (ERC-7412) or KursPyth.updatePriceFeeds
- [/api/x402?pair=USD/IDR](https://kurs-ten-zeta.vercel.app/api/x402?pair=USD/IDR): the same bundle behind x402 (HTTP 402, 0.001 USDC on Base Sepolia, exact scheme)
- [/api/quote?amount=100&from=USD&to=IDR](https://kurs-ten-zeta.vercel.app/api/quote?amount=100&from=USD&to=IDR): convert with on-chain prices (direct, inverse or via USD), every round with its age; maxAge=<s> refuses older prices (409)
- [/api/metrics](https://kurs-ten-zeta.vercel.app/api/metrics): Prometheus metrics (feed age, answer, freshness, relayer balance, 1 h TWAP and deviation, feed-config drift)
- [/api/health](https://kurs-ten-zeta.vercel.app/api/health): age of every feed on every network
- [/api/history?net=portaldot&pair=USD/IDR](https://kurs-ten-zeta.vercel.app/api/history?net=portaldot&pair=USD/IDR): every round since deployment
- [/api/substrate](https://kurs-ten-zeta.vercel.app/api/substrate): Portaldot prices read through the Substrate runtime API ReviveApi_call
- [/api/mcp](https://kurs-ten-zeta.vercel.app/api/mcp): Model Context Protocol server (Streamable HTTP) with tools list_feeds, get_price, convert (direct, inverse or via USD; each round returned with its age; maxAgeSeconds refuses stale prices), get_history, get_signed_bundle, verify_bundle (recovers every EIP-712 signer against the on-chain reporter set and quorum) and get_twap

## Contracts

- Portaldot V3 testnet (chain id 420420777, RPC https://test-evm-rpc-v3.portaldot.dev): KursOracle 0x5bdd9713ddc4f11e14bd3094882401cd122656f4, KursDIA (DIA getValue) 0x969b85f2c66b8504bb4f33e16333e7328187dfd9
- Sepolia: KursOracle 0xd3f6bf8e595e815de11598f23170b37341a2cbc3, KursQuoteOracle (ERC-7726 + Euler IPriceOracle) 0xc1764dea11e988cecdb5b7c92811fbbfe3550316, KursSiloOracle (Silo v2, quote IDR) 0xd43c69cb8b474772eeb4b8132a54fc44044992c3, KursTwap BTC/USD 0x2f4385f565568b8f835ed8419f02b99bd0754f15 and USD/IDR 0x4738a3f8931918fc0c56cad53f65e2f4a508fadb (consult(window), observe(secondsAgos)), KursTwapKeeper (Chainlink Automation checkUpkeep/performUpkeep, Gelato checker) 0xa1f36550f41da000bfa1ac9cdffb32ed08b43abc, KursQuoteOracle v1 (ERC-7726, used by KursMorphoOracle) 0x787e4f515d1affa6a3dff10ee953f236db90cf30, KursPyth (IPyth) 0x22cd6de783b69a2742a389c037dbe77999fabaa7, KursMorphoOracle (BTC/IDR) 0xdcdc450ff50f0925e3b9ca5b83db92e7614026e5, KursDIA 0x77c993404504bc06e415273332fffcd36a8f42ec, KursBand 0xd3bc38c7ac048efeaf3d16e88a04810d96878fc0, KursApi3ReaderProxy BTC/USD 0x4642c5d754195847ae94b5ab7032a16c41ab5cd6 and USD/IDR 0x32559c5874d123cf5f173bf822ba7a1e83cf07e0, KursChronicle BTC/USD 0x7135784d38e360c37980fc2cf2840212a07f938e, KursAaveOracle 0x537c2d9059ceb8d9c8e1eb289fb07153d61d8f73
